You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Kayden Miranda. Community gardener. From Columbus, Ohio. Last night,
A person, maybe 50s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Irving Wallace. Glazier. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Carpenter's square, Field suture kit, Coat button, Trail compass, Tasting Spoon. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night,
